(shrī)༄༅/ /mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang bya tshul skyid shod pa'i yig cha las byung ba'o/ /༄༅/ /mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang la/gtor

tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang bya tshul skyid shod pa'i yig cha las byung ba'o// ༄༅// mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang la/ gtor ma/ maṇḍal/ mchod gtor rnams bar chad kun sel dang 'dra/ slob dpon gyis yi dam gyi sgom bzlas dang*/ mdun gyi maṇḍal gtor ma rnams bsang sbyang mgon por bskyed/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug mchod bstod bsnyen pa gtor 'bul sogs dkyus ltar bya/ mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i slob ma re re tsam khrus byas gser gyi maṇḍal dbul/ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang*/ khyod zhabs sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ spyi bye brag gi chos bshad cing lha

mngon rtogs ltar/ ngo sprad/ de dag gi steng gi nam mkha' la zhes pa nas/ thun mong ba'i sdom pa 'dzin pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum bya/ thun mong min pa'i sdom pa 'dzin pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis sngags sdom bzung*/ cho ga gsum gyis mgon po gtso rkyang bskyed/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod/ de nas rjes gnang dngos gzhi 'bul bar byed pa la/ bla mas slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ bu khyod la ni bdag gis ni// nag po chen po'i dam tshig bsgrag /bsam gyis mi khyab dpe byad dang*// mtshan bzang gar dgu'i nyams ldan pa// bsgom dang dmigs bzlas mchod gtor gyis// sngags rgyun drag po'i phyag len sogs// drag tu bcangs shing bzlas pa bya// las kyi sgrub pa ci byed kyang*// bla ma mchod cing gsol ba gdab// sgrub pa'i thabs rang bsgrub pa bas// ring du gyur la byams pa spongs// byang chub sems dang ldan par byos// zhes dam la bzhag de nas khyod rang rnams tshangs pa'i bu ga nas gsang gnas kyi bar drang por rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba spyi bo nas snying ga yan yangs shing spyi bo'i tshangs bug kha gdang de yod pa'i snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du khyod rang gi snying gyen du ldog ste log pa padma 'dab brgyad du song ba'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du rang sems hūm̐ yig sngon po zhig tu song ba'i mos pa mdzod/ spyi bo nas tshangs bug gi 'khris su ye shes kyi mgon po bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzad par zhu/ slob ma'i spyi bor padma dang nyi ma dang tshogs bdag gi steng du dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag ces pa nas/ me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon gser gyi dril bu bsnams pa bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ yid la dran pa tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa/ gsol ba btab na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa zhig bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzad nas de nyid la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma mgon po dbyer mi phyed pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig da ltar nyid du= myur ba nyid du= 'dug sa 'di nyid du= de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs pa'i mgon po la phog pas nya la lcags kyus btab pa bzhin du rang dbang med par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i thad du ḍa ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra sgrog cing khyod kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas bsgrub bo// zhes gsung lhang lhang byon nas spyi bo'i mgon po dam tshig pa la thim pas de nyid bsil ba tshal gyi mgon po ye shes par gyur song snyam pa mdzod/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla mas mgon po de nyid dbu ma'i nang nas mar bstims byung ba rang sems hūm̐ yig tu gsol ba de la thim pas/ dngul chu la dngul chu thim pa bzhin du dbyer med du gyur te ye shes kyi mgon po'i skur gyur pa ni sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag drug zhes pa nas/ klong dkyil na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ de ltar rang nyid ye shes kyi mgon po snang stong gnyis tshogs sgyu ma lta bu'i sku de nga'o snyam pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par 'jog par zhu byas la mnyam par 'jog tu bcug

slar yang bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung ba rtsa dbu ma'i nang brgyud snying ga'i padma mgon po dang bcas pa la sogs pa padma bum sku ltar 'ub kyis 'dus pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rtse lnga pa tog nag po'i lte ba la hūm̐ dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bla ma'i zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba phyung ste rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas mar zhugs te snying ga'i mgon po padma bum sku ltar kha zum pa de nyid byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin cing 'bral med du bzhugs nas byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir du bum sku phyi nang gi snying po'i sngags kyi yig 'bru 'od zer 'phro ba'i drwa ba'i rnam pa can gyi thag pas gru gu ltar bsdams pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir du snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ badzra ma hā kā la tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod/ de nas gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i spyi bo'i oṃ yig las 'od zer dkar po byung*/ slob ma mgon por gsal ba dang snying ga'i mgon po'i spyi bo'i oṃ yig la thim pas/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag bum pa'i dbang dang sku'i byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas/ sngags rol bya/ de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po dang*/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung*/ slob ma mgon por gsal ba dang snying ga'i mgon po'i mgrin pa dang snying ga'i yig 'bru la thim pas ngag dang yid kyi sgrib pa dag gsang dbang dang gsung gi byin rlabs dang*/ sher dbang dang thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa byed/ yang gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum rbad chad nas slob ma dang snying ga'i mgon po'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum la thim pas lus ngag yid gsum byed pa dang bcas pa'i sgrib pa dag tshig dbang dang yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gtor ma mgo thog tu 'jog pa'i skabs su bla ma mgon po spyi bor byon nas dgyes bzhin du khyed rang rnams mgon por gsal ba dang*/

khyad par du yang snying ga'i rang sems mgon por gsal ba la sib sib thim pas bla ma mgon po'i byin rlabs zhugs te bla ma mgon po rang gi shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems dang ngo bo dbyer med du song snyam pa mdzod byas la/ gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag nas dril bu gsil zhing*/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// ji ltar bka' bsgos dam bcas dran mdzod la// skal ldan bu yi 'gal rkyen kun sel zhing*// mthun rkyen mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ mjug chog spyi ltar bya'o/ mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang bya tshul kun dang thun mong min pa zhal shes snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa yi ger bkod pa yin pas skal ldan slob ma re re tsam ma gtogs mang por mi spel ba gal che zhing snod min la ches cher gsang bar bya'o// shin tu bkra shis so// sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha wantu// ༈ /mgon po phyag drug pa snying zhugs bka' rgya ma'o/ dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so// thugs rje'i gter chen bla ma mgon po la// byang chub snying po'i bar du gus btud nas// de yi rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa// snyan brgyud zab mo mdor bsdus bri bar bya// de la 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i gang zag gis/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon tu btang*/ rang gi rang yi dam gang rung ngam mgon por bsgoms kyang rung gsungs/ mchan/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma sbom phra sba lcag tsam/ yar sna tshangs bug tu slebs shing*/ mar sna snying ga bud pa tsam du yod pa'i snying padma 'dab brgyad dmar po/ bum sku kha bsdus pa lta bu'i rtse mor rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga'i tog gis mtshan pa/ padma'i dbus su shin tu phra ba'i thig le dkar dmar gyi nang du rang sems myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig rtse mor ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing*/

zhabs kyu las byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa/ mgon po'i sku dang snying ga'i padma bum sku las me 'od dag tu 'phro bar gyur par bsam/ rang gi spyi bor pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gam̐ las tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas thod pa dang g.yon la phug 'dzin pa/ mgo bo g.yas su bstan gan rkyal du bsgyel ba/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus gri gug sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ cher 'bar rab tu khros shing shin tu rngams pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum po glog ltar 'khyug cing*/ khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ sma ra dang smin ma dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ ljags rnam par 'dril zhing ha ha'i gad rgyangs 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug gnyis pa na thod pa'i phreng ba/ gsum pa na thod pa'i ḍa ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ phyag g.yon gyi dang po na thod khrag gnyis pa na rtse gsum/ gsum pa na rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing*/ dmar pos snyan rgyan/ khra bos dpung rgyan/ dkar pos mgul rgyan/ ser pos lag gdub/ ljang gus do shal/ dkar pos ska rags dang rkang gdub byas pa/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs la dar ljang gu'i ska rags bcing ba/ lto ba rab tu 'phyang zhing yan lag rags la bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ dpral bar sindhu ras legs par byugs shing*/ spyi bor mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa/ phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha sgra dang bcas pas rab tu brgyan cing*/

glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gos su gyon pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mgon po'i spyi gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ phyag g.yon gser gyi dril bu bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing rin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pas spras pa/ bla ma dang mgon po gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ drin can rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad spyan drangs/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badzra bī ra bāai re na shrī ye/ ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ dzo ka dzo ki nī/ sarba buddha ya/ bo dhi sa twa sha ra ṇaṃ gatstsha mi/ kye kye/ lan gsum brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bla ma de nyid bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ spyi bor bla ma dang mgon po dang snying ga'i mgon po gsum ka'i thugs ka las 'od zer 'phros pa gcig tu gyur nas/ shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod shing tsandan rkang gcig pa'i drung nas nag po chen po skad cig gis spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod nas// dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur byon ma hā kā la che// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la e hye hi kṣiṃ kṣiṃ/ nyer gcig dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces brjod pas bsil ba'i tshal gyi mgon po de nyid ḍa ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas te/ zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi 'gal rkyen thams cad ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas bsgrub ces pa'i gsung lhang lhang byon bzhin pa spyi bo'i bla ma mgon po la thim pas/ de nyid mgon po dngos su gyur te/

zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog cing*/ rang gi nad gdon spyi dang khyad par steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/ bar gdon btsan dang rgyal 'gong*/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bya sgro mes bsregs pa ltar gzhob thul gyis bsregs/ gri gug gi sos nyil nyil gtubs cing sha khrag rus gsum gyi rnam par zhal du dmar chil chil gsol bar bsam/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo spros te mchod par bsams la/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar dang*/ rū pa nas/ sparshe'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ spros pa'i lha mo dang snyoms par bzhugs pas bde ba chen pos dgyes par gyur par bsam/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas// skad cig gis ni thob 'gyur ba// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// ma rungs kun 'dul khros pa'i sku// bstan pa'i ru tra 'joms mdzad pa'i// nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ sa gzhi spos kyi byugs shing zhes sogs kyis maṇḍal phul/ de nas gdung shugs drag pos/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gis bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje 'chang dang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po la phog pas mgon po sku mdog ljang nag tu gyur par bsgom gsungs/ mchan/ 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'bar 'ur 'ur sil sil gar mdzad cing*/ mgon po'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma la phog pas bla ma 'od kyi bla ma sku mdog ljang ser du gyur par bsgom/ mchan/ rang bzhin du mer mer dril bu'i sgra sgrog bla ma nyid mgon po/ mgon po nyid bla ma/

bla ma dang mgon po dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sku bzhi'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs so// dpal ldan sha ba ri dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs so// rje btsun mai tri pa chen po la= grub chen rā hu la chen po la gsol= mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la= mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus la= dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po la= gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la= chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa la= mkhas grub shangs ston chen po la= mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la= sngags 'chang rdo rje gzhon nu la= mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa chen po la gsol= chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po la= mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po la= paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan la= grub chen chos kyi rdo rje la= rgyal ba blo bzang don grub la= mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes la= paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la= rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la= skyid shod ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las la= rje blo bzang chos 'phel la= rje blo bzang dar rgyas la= rje blo bzang sbyin pa la= rje ngag dbang mchog ldan la= kha skong ni/ kun mkhyen rol pa'i rdo rje la= rje btsun dkon mchog bde chen la= 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma la= 'jam mgon don grub rgyal mtshan la= zhes so// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la= phyag drug ye shes kyi mgon po la= mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la= mgon po myur mdzad thugs rje can la= bla ma mgon po dbyer med la= mgon po bla ma dbyer med la= de ltar gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ mgon po'i zhal nas khyod kyi bar chad thams cad ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas sgrub bo zhes gsung lhang lhang bzhugs par bsams la/ na mo buddhā ya/

na mo gu ru he/ badzra bī ra bī re na shrī ye/ ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ dzo ka dzo ki nī/ sarba buddhā ya/ bo dhi satwa/ sha ra ṇaṃ gatstshā mi/ kye kye/ zhes gang mang brjod pas/ spyi bo'i bla ma mgon po'i sku

'di skabs spyi bo'i bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa dang*/ mgon po'i gnas gsum las sku dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa byung ste rang la thim par bsgom gsungs/ mchan/ las bdud rtsi dang 'od zer kha dog sna lnga dang*/ mgon po'i sku bong thung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa byung ste rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ nad gdon gyi sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te mgon po'i zhal du gsol bas dag par gyur zhing*/ tshe bsod nams dpal 'byor lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rgyas par gyur par bsams la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin= dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig ces brjod pas/ mgon po'i spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po dang mgon po'i sku dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon/ rang gi dpral bar zhugs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po dang mgon po'i sku dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon/ rang gi mgrin par zhugs/ ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dag

gsang ba'i dbang thob/ longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po dang mgon po'i sku sngon po dpag tu med pa byon/ rang gi yid la zhugs/ yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag slar yang gnas lnga las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga dang*/ mgon po'i sku kha dog sna lnga dpag tu med pa byon/ rang gi gnas lngar zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par bsam/ de nas slar yang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis= dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis= bla ma dang ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig da lta nyid du= myur ba nyid du= 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig khyad par bdag gi snying padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su byon te byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'bral ba med par brtan par bzhugs la/ tshe 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad las bskyab tu gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ spyi bo'i bla ma mgon po'i zhabs 'og gi tshogs bdag mi dmigs par bzhag par byas te/ zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyis byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen thams cad ngas sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad ngas bsgrub/

ces pa'i gsung lhang lhang dang bcas te tshangs bug nas zhugs te sngags kyi sgra sgrogs bzhin pas gar stabs ling de dbu ma'i nang nas mar byon snying ga'i mgon po la thim zhing bla ma'i bum sku'i tog gi rdo rje la thim pas rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar hūm̐ yig ser pos mtshan par gyur par bsam/ de nas mgon po'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer du mtha'i me 'od lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad gzhob thul gyis bsregs/ rang gi sha rus gdos bcas kyi lus 'di myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i skur lam gyis gyur/ ces nga rgyal brtan po bya/ de nas ye shes kyi me 'od stong gsum thams cad khyab par 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyang ye shes kyi mgon po'i skur gyur pas sngags kyi sgra 'ur 'ur sgrog par mos te/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣeṃ kṣeṃ bi ghān bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇe/ e ṣa a pashtsi/ ma ka lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ ratna tra ya/ a pa ka rī ṇāṃ/ ya di pra tī dzñā/ sma ra si twa da/ i daṃ duṣṭāṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa rnams ci nus su bzla/ mjug tu/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la// bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus sel bar shog /mgon po bla ma dbyer med la// bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi// bar chad ma lus sel bar shog /ces pa gsum mam bdun sogs brjod/ dus rgyun du sngags bzla shā sa na dang bcas/ mchan/ ba'i tshe snying ga'i mgon po'i thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la dmigs pa gtad nas bzlas na legs shing*/

gtor ma dang mchod pa sogs kyang snying ga'i mgon po la phul bas chog par gsungs so// de ltar 'bad pas nyams su blangs nas gnas skabs su nad gdon bar gcod gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing*// tshe bsod mthar rdo rje'i bzlas pa spyi ltar bya/ mchan/ dpal 'byor dam chos bshad sgrub sogs 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyis 'di phyi bar do thams cad du 'bral ba med par rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa yin pas/ gzhan la gsang bas nyams su len pa gal che zhing*/ zhib cha bla ma'i zhal las shes phal cher mchan gsal ltar ro// mchan/ par bya dgos so// smras pa/ bla ma lha dang rang sems dbyer med du// rtse gcig bsgom zhing yid ches gsol btab pas// don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub byed lha mchog der// snying nas blo gtad gang de skal ba bzang*// 'dir 'bad dge ba sprin bral zla zer ltar// mchog tu dkar ba ji snyed thob pa des// skye dang skye bar bla mgon dbyer med kyis// rjes bzung rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /ces pa bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa shin tu zab pa 'di ni/ rang gi bla ma'i zhal shes ji lta ba bzhin du/ rig pa 'dzin pa 7lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes go bde bklags chog tu bsgrigs pa yin pas/ rjes gnang ma thob pa dang snod min rnams la gsang bar bya'o// 'dis kyang bstan pa rgyas par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/ yig cha 'di'i steng nas khrid rgyun lung bcas ka chen rin po che blo bzang dge legs kyi zhal snga nas/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun por nos so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
